items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Melrose used to publish his pieces... he'd write up a tune and give it to Melrose

ctx.x: Do you think Jelly Roll wrote it?
Yeah, I think so. Excuse me.

Jelly Roll wrote a lot of things. Every time he wanted something he used to -- Melrose used to publish his pieces, you know, and every time he wanted $1,000, $2,000, or anything he'd write up a tune and give it to Melrose and say, 'Give me some advance money.' And that's how he used to get his money. And he had a diamond in his tooth in front there and he was a pimp, and he can talk himself into a job and talk himself out of it. He was quite a guy.
